name: Prime Factorization Isomorphism
description: Replaced the matrix determinant (which yielded primes 2, 3, 5 with target 3^m) with a structurally identical exponential function (yielding primes 3, 5, 7 with target 5^m). This completely removes the "determinant" keyword that models used to trigger their bipartite graph recognition, while preserving the exact mathematical constraints and edge-by-edge product structure of the seed.
